_comment: Every file the web app needs at runtime, in one place.
The PC portable package used to hand-list its files and had drifted: it shipped
voyage_manager.html without eorb.js or ship_time.js, so every download 404'd on
both and sailed without the e-ORB module or the ship-time logic. Each packaging
path — www/ for Android, the portable zip, the Windows installer — now reads this
list, and tests/check_assets.js asserts it covers every script the page loads.
